sentences.text: Anak tetangga Andi masih lugu dan percaya semua cerita kakaknya.
sentences.en: Andi's neighbor's kid is still naive and believes every story the older sibling tells.
sentences.ko: 안디네 이웃집 아이는 아직 순진해서 언니 오빠가 하는 이야기를 다 믿어요.

sentences.text: Kata Dewi, murid baru itu masih lugu dan mengira semua biola sama saja.
sentences.en: According to Dewi, the new student is still naive and thinks all violins are the same.
sentences.ko: 데위 말로는 새로 온 학생이 아직 순진해서 바이올린이 다 똑같은 줄 알아요.

sentences.text: Para ibu di gang sering menjodohkan Andi karena masih perjaka di usia tiga puluh.
sentences.en: The women in the alley often try to set Andi up because he's still a bachelor at thirty.
sentences.ko: 골목 아주머니들은 안디가 서른인데 아직 총각이라 자꾸 중매를 서려고 해요.

sentences.text: Guru gitar yang masih perjaka itu sering digoda rekan-rekan Dewi.
sentences.en: Dewi's colleagues often tease the guitar teacher who is still a bachelor.
sentences.ko: 데위의 동료들은 아직 총각인 기타 선생님을 자주 놀려요.

sentences.text: Pak Darto selalu sinis setiap kali Andi mengusulkan kerja bakti.
sentences.en: Pak Darto is always cynical whenever Andi proposes a community clean-up.
sentences.ko: 다르토 씨는 안디가 동네 대청소를 제안할 때마다 늘 냉소적이에요.

sentences.text: Seorang kritikus menulis ulasan sinis tentang konser murid-murid Dewi.
sentences.en: A critic wrote a cynical review of the concert by Dewi's students.
sentences.ko: 한 평론가가 데위 학생들의 연주회에 대해 냉소적인 평을 썼어요.

sentences.text: Kakek di ujung gang dulu seorang gembala kambing, cerita Andi.
sentences.en: The old man at the end of the alley used to be a goat herder, Andi says.
sentences.ko: 안디 말로는 골목 끝 할아버지가 예전에 염소 목동이었대요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengajarkan lagu daerah tentang seorang gembala dan seruling bambu.
sentences.en: Dewi teaches a folk song about a shepherd and a bamboo flute.
sentences.ko: 데위는 목동과 대나무 피리에 관한 민요를 가르쳐요.

sentences.text: Andi selalu jadi pemberi kabar pertama kalau ada tetangga yang sakit.
sentences.en: Andi is always the first to pass on the news when a neighbor is sick.
sentences.ko: 이웃이 아프면 늘 안디가 제일 먼저 소식을 전해요.

sentences.text: Sekolah musik tempat Dewi mengajar berterima kasih kepada para pemberi beasiswa.
sentences.en: The music school where Dewi teaches thanked the scholarship donors.
sentences.ko: 데위가 가르치는 음악 학교는 장학금 후원자들에게 감사를 전했어요.

sentences.text: Andi ikut menjadi pengiring pengantin di pernikahan anak tetangga.
sentences.en: Andi was one of the groom's escorts at the neighbor's child's wedding.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃집 자녀 결혼식에서 신랑 들러리를 섰어요.

sentences.text: Setiap Sabtu, Dewi menjadi pengiring piano untuk paduan suara anak.
sentences.en: Every Saturday, Dewi is the piano accompanist for the children's choir.
sentences.ko: 토요일마다 데위는 어린이 합창단의 피아노 반주를 맡아요.

sentences.text: Andi masih merawat pohon mangga yang ditanam mendiang Pak Harun.
sentences.en: Andi still takes care of the mango tree planted by the late Pak Harun.
sentences.ko: 안디는 지금도 고(故) 하룬 씨가 심은 망고나무를 돌봐요.

sentences.text: Piano tua di kelas Dewi adalah peninggalan mendiang pendiri sekolah.
sentences.en: The old piano in Dewi's classroom was left by the school's late founder.
sentences.ko: 데위 교실의 낡은 피아노는 돌아가신 학교 설립자가 남긴 거예요.

sentences.text: Rumah kos di sebelah Andi dihuni beberapa mahasiswi kedokteran.
sentences.en: The boarding house next to Andi's is home to several female medical students.
sentences.ko: 안디네 옆 하숙집에는 의대 여학생 몇 명이 살아요.

sentences.text: Seorang mahasiswi konservatori membantu Dewi mengajar kelas biola.
sentences.en: A female conservatory student helps Dewi teach the violin class.
sentences.ko: 음악원 여대생 한 명이 데위의 바이올린 수업을 도와요.

sentences.text: Bagi anak-anak di gang, Andi adalah teladan karena rajin membantu orang tua.
sentences.en: For the kids in the alley, Andi is a role model because he always helps the elderly.
sentences.ko: 골목 아이들에게 안디는 어르신들을 잘 도와서 본보기예요.

sentences.text: Dewi memberi penghargaan murid teladan kepada Rina yang tak pernah bolos latihan.
sentences.en: Dewi gave the model student award to Rina, who never skipped practice.
sentences.ko: 데위는 연습에 한 번도 빠지지 않은 리나에게 모범생 상을 줬어요.

sentences.text: Andi membaca berita tentang penjudi yang ditangkap di kampung sebelah.
sentences.en: Andi read the news about gamblers arrested in the next village.
sentences.ko: 안디는 옆 동네에서 도박꾼들이 잡혔다는 기사를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Murid-murid Dewi mementaskan opera tentang seorang penjudi yang kehilangan segalanya.
sentences.en: Dewi's students staged an opera about a gambler who loses everything.
sentences.ko: 데위의 학생들은 모든 것을 잃은 도박꾼에 관한 오페라를 무대에 올렸어요.

sentences.text: Bu Sari gigih menagih iuran sampah sampai Andi akhirnya membayar.
sentences.en: Bu Sari kept stubbornly collecting the trash fee until Andi finally paid.
sentences.ko: 사리 씨가 쓰레기 회비를 끈질기게 걷어서 안디가 결국 냈어요.

sentences.text: Dewi memuji murid yang gigih berlatih tangga nada setiap hari.
sentences.en: Dewi praised the student who persistently practices scales every day.
sentences.ko: 데위는 매일 꾸준히 음계를 연습하는 학생을 칭찬했어요.

sentences.text: Andi menerima paket dari pengirim yang tidak dikenal.
sentences.en: Andi received a package from an unknown sender.
sentences.ko: 안디는 모르는 사람이 보낸 택배를 받았어요.

sentences.text: Dewi menerima karangan bunga, tetapi nama pengirim tidak tertulis di kartu.
sentences.en: Dewi received a bouquet, but the sender's name wasn't written on the card.
sentences.ko: 데위는 꽃다발을 받았지만 카드에 보낸 사람 이름이 없었어요.

sentences.text: Andi sedih melihat tetangga-tetangga lama mulai menua.
sentences.en: Andi is sad to see his longtime neighbors growing old.
sentences.ko: 안디는 오랜 이웃들이 늙어 가는 걸 보며 마음이 아파요.

sentences.text: Dewi ingin terus mengajar musik sampai menua.
sentences.en: Dewi wants to keep teaching music until she grows old.
sentences.ko: 데위는 늙을 때까지 계속 음악을 가르치고 싶어요.

sentences.text: Penghuni baru di ujung jalan terkesan angkuh, tetapi Andi tetap menyapa.
sentences.en: The new resident at the end of the street seems arrogant, but Andi still says hello.
sentences.ko: 길 끝에 새로 온 사람은 거만해 보이지만 안디는 그래도 인사해요.

sentences.text: Pianis tamu itu angkuh dan tidak mau menyapa murid-murid Dewi.
sentences.en: The guest pianist was arrogant and wouldn't greet Dewi's students.
sentences.ko: 그 초청 피아니스트는 거만해서 데위의 학생들에게 인사도 하지 않았어요.

sentences.text: Andi dan tetangga sebelah punya kecocokan dalam selera musik.
sentences.en: Andi and the neighbor next door have a lot in common in their taste in music.
sentences.ko: 안디와 옆집 사람은 음악 취향이 잘 맞아요.

sentences.text: Dewi memasangkan murid untuk duet berdasarkan kecocokan tempo dan gaya.
sentences.en: Dewi pairs students for duets based on how well their tempo and style match.
sentences.ko: 데위는 템포와 스타일이 잘 맞는지 보고 학생들을 이중주 짝으로 묶어요.

sentences.text: Andi membaca buku sejarah tentang perlawanan kaum pribumi pada masa kolonial.
sentences.en: Andi read a history book about the resistance of native people in the colonial era.
sentences.ko: 안디는 식민지 시대 원주민들의 저항에 관한 역사책을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Untuk kelas sejarah musik, Dewi mempelajari lagu-lagu suku pribumi Australia.
sentences.en: For the music history class, Dewi studied songs of Australia's native peoples.
sentences.ko: 데위는 음악사 수업을 위해 호주 원주민 부족의 노래를 공부했어요.

sentences.text: Anak tetangga yang bandel itu memanjat pagar rumah Andi lagi.
sentences.en: That naughty neighbor kid climbed over Andi's fence again.
sentences.ko: 그 말썽꾸러기 이웃집 아이가 또 안디네 담을 넘었어요.

sentences.text: Murid yang bandel itu sering memainkan lagu pop di tengah pelajaran Dewi.
sentences.en: That unruly student often plays pop songs in the middle of Dewi's lessons.
sentences.ko: 그 말썽꾸러기 학생은 데위의 수업 중에 자주 팝송을 연주해요.

sentences.text: Burung beo milik Andi adalah peniru suara yang hebat.
sentences.en: Andi's parrot is a great mimic of sounds.
sentences.ko: 안디가 키우는 앵무새는 소리 흉내를 기막히게 내요.

sentences.text: Dewi bilang murid itu peniru yang hebat, tetapi belum punya gaya sendiri.
sentences.en: Dewi says that student is a great imitator but doesn't have a style of their own yet.
sentences.ko: 데위는 그 학생이 흉내는 잘 내지만 아직 자기 스타일이 없다고 해요.

sentences.text: Pak Darmo menyebut Andi kamerad karena mereka sama-sama suka main catur.
sentences.en: Pak Darmo calls Andi "comrade" because they both love playing chess.
sentences.ko: 다르모 씨는 둘 다 체스를 좋아해서 안디를 동지라고 불러요.

sentences.text: Dalam opera yang dilatih Dewi, para prajurit saling memanggil kamerad.
sentences.en: In the opera Dewi is rehearsing, the soldiers call each other comrade.
sentences.ko: 데위가 연습시키는 오페라에서 군인들은 서로를 동지라고 불러요.

sentences.text: Keluarga di sebelah Andi hidup bersahaja meski cukup kaya.
sentences.en: The family next to Andi lives simply even though they're fairly well off.
sentences.ko: 안디네 옆집 가족은 꽤 부유한데도 소박하게 살아요.

sentences.text: Meski sudah terkenal, Dewi tetap tampil bersahaja di depan murid.
sentences.en: Even though she's famous, Dewi stays down-to-earth in front of her students.
sentences.ko: 데위는 유명해졌어도 학생들 앞에서는 여전히 소탈해요.

sentences.text: Andi jarang melihat tetangga penyendiri itu keluar rumah.
sentences.en: Andi rarely sees that reclusive neighbor leave the house.
sentences.ko: 안디는 그 혼자 지내는 이웃이 집 밖에 나오는 걸 거의 못 봐요.

sentences.text: Murid penyendiri itu baru berani bicara setelah Dewi mengajarinya main cello.
sentences.en: The loner student only dared to speak after Dewi taught him to play the cello.
sentences.ko: 혼자 지내던 그 학생은 데위에게 첼로를 배우고 나서야 말을 꺼냈어요.

sentences.text: Konon pemilik rumah besar di ujung gang itu seorang jutawan, kata Andi.
sentences.en: They say the owner of the big house at the end of the alley is a millionaire, Andi says.
sentences.ko: 안디 말로는 골목 끝 큰 집 주인이 백만장자래요.

sentences.text: Seorang jutawan menyumbangkan grand piano ke sekolah musik Dewi.
sentences.en: A millionaire donated a grand piano to Dewi's music school.
sentences.ko: 한 백만장자가 데위의 음악 학교에 그랜드 피아노를 기증했어요.

sentences.text: Andi baru tahu bahwa anak tetangga kidal saat mereka main bulu tangkis.
sentences.en: Andi only found out the neighbor's kid is left-handed when they played badminton.
sentences.ko: 안디는 배드민턴을 치다가 이웃집 아이가 왼손잡이라는 걸 알았어요.

sentences.text: Dewi mencarikan gitar khusus untuk murid yang kidal.
sentences.en: Dewi found a special guitar for the left-handed student.
sentences.ko: 데위는 왼손잡이 학생을 위해 전용 기타를 구해 줬어요.

sentences.text: Andi membawa kue sebagai tanda perkenalan kepada tetangga baru.
sentences.en: Andi brought cake to the new neighbors as a way of introducing himself.
sentences.ko: 안디는 새 이웃에게 인사 겸 케이크를 가져갔어요.

sentences.text: Kelas pertama Dewi selalu dibuka dengan perkenalan singkat.
sentences.en: Dewi's first class always opens with brief introductions.
sentences.ko: 데위의 첫 수업은 늘 짧은 자기소개로 시작해요.

sentences.text: Andi terdiam ketika tetangga bercerita tentang anaknya yang sakit keras.
sentences.en: Andi fell silent when the neighbor talked about their seriously ill child.
sentences.ko: 이웃이 중병에 걸린 아이 이야기를 하자 안디는 말을 잃었어요.

sentences.text: Seluruh aula terdiam ketika murid kecil Dewi mulai bernyanyi.
sentences.en: The whole hall fell silent when Dewi's young student began to sing.
sentences.ko: 데위의 어린 제자가 노래를 시작하자 강당 전체가 조용해졌어요.

sentences.text: Kucing liar itu terpojok di garasi Andi dan mendesis keras.
sentences.en: The stray cat was cornered in Andi's garage and hissed loudly.
sentences.ko: 그 길고양이는 안디네 차고 구석에 몰려서 크게 하악질을 했어요.

sentences.text: Dewi merasa terpojok ketika para orang tua mengeluhkan jadwal resital.
sentences.en: Dewi felt cornered when the parents complained about the recital schedule.
sentences.ko: 학부모들이 발표회 일정에 불만을 쏟아내자 데위는 궁지에 몰린 기분이었어요.

sentences.text: Andi dan Pak RT punya perbedaan pendapat yang mendasar soal parkir di gang.
sentences.en: Andi and the neighborhood head have a fundamental disagreement about parking in the alley.
sentences.ko: 안디와 반장님은 골목 주차 문제에 대해 근본적으로 생각이 달라요.

sentences.text: Dewi mengajarkan teknik mendasar seperti posisi jari dan cara bernapas.
sentences.en: Dewi teaches basic techniques like finger position and breathing.
sentences.ko: 데위는 손가락 위치와 호흡법 같은 기본기를 가르쳐요.

sentences.text: Andi butuh waktu untuk mencerna kabar bahwa tetangga terbaiknya akan pindah.
sentences.en: Andi needed time to take in the news that his best neighbor was moving away.
sentences.ko: 안디는 가장 친한 이웃이 이사 간다는 소식을 받아들이는 데 시간이 걸렸어요.

sentences.text: Murid-murid butuh waktu untuk mencerna teori harmoni yang Dewi ajarkan.
sentences.en: The students need time to digest the harmony theory Dewi teaches.
sentences.ko: 학생들은 데위가 가르치는 화성학을 소화하는 데 시간이 걸려요.

sentences.text: Warga menggelar tikar di jalan untuk syukuran, dan Andi membawa nasi kuning.
sentences.en: The residents spread mats on the street for a thanksgiving meal, and Andi brought yellow rice.
sentences.ko: 주민들이 감사 잔치를 하려고 길에 돗자리를 깔았고 안디는 노란 밥을 가져왔어요.

sentences.text: Sekolah musik Dewi menggelar resital akhir tahun di gedung kesenian.
sentences.en: Dewi's music school holds a year-end recital at the arts center.
sentences.ko: 데위의 음악 학교는 예술 회관에서 연말 발표회를 열어요.

sentences.text: Andi membantu tetangga memandikan anjing besar mereka di halaman.
sentences.en: Andi helped the neighbors bathe their big dog in the yard.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃이 마당에서 큰 개를 씻기는 걸 도왔어요.

sentences.text: Pagi ini Dewi terlambat mengajar karena harus memandikan bayi dulu.
sentences.en: This morning Dewi was late for class because she had to bathe the baby first.
sentences.ko: 오늘 아침 데위는 아기를 먼저 씻겨야 해서 수업에 늦었어요.

sentences.text: Bu Sari meneteskan air mata saat Andi mengembalikan dompet yang hilang.
sentences.en: Bu Sari shed tears when Andi returned the lost wallet.
sentences.ko: 안디가 잃어버린 지갑을 돌려주자 사리 씨는 눈물을 흘렸어요.

sentences.text: Dewi meneteskan minyak katup ke trompet yang macet.
sentences.en: Dewi put a few drops of valve oil on the stuck trumpet.
sentences.ko: 데위는 뻑뻑한 트럼펫에 밸브 오일을 몇 방울 떨어뜨렸어요.

sentences.text: Pindah rumah adalah keputusan terberat bagi Andi karena tetangganya begitu baik.
sentences.en: Moving was the hardest decision for Andi because his neighbors are so kind.
sentences.ko: 이웃들이 너무 좋아서 이사는 안디에게 가장 힘든 결정이었어요.

sentences.text: Kata Dewi, bagian terberat lagu itu adalah nada tinggi di akhir.
sentences.en: According to Dewi, the hardest part of that song is the high note at the end.
sentences.ko: 데위 말로는 그 노래에서 가장 어려운 부분은 끝의 고음이에요.

sentences.text: Andi tidak menyangka memperbaiki atap rumah tetangga bisa sesulit itu.
sentences.en: Andi didn't expect fixing the neighbor's roof to be that hard.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃집 지붕 고치는 일이 그렇게 어려울 줄 몰랐어요.

sentences.text: Dewi bilang bermain harpa tidak sesulit kelihatannya.
sentences.en: Dewi says playing the harp isn't as hard as it looks.
sentences.ko: 데위는 하프 연주가 보기만큼 어렵지 않다고 해요.

sentences.text: Lupa mengunci pagar adalah kesalahan terbodoh Andi minggu ini.
sentences.en: Forgetting to lock the gate was Andi's dumbest mistake this week.
sentences.ko: 대문 잠그는 걸 잊은 건 안디가 이번 주에 한 가장 바보 같은 실수였어요.

sentences.text: Dewi tertawa dan menyebut lupa membawa partitur sebagai kesalahan terbodoh hari itu.
sentences.en: Dewi laughed and called forgetting the sheet music the dumbest mistake of the day.
sentences.ko: 데위는 웃으면서 악보를 깜빡한 게 그날 가장 바보 같은 실수였다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Dari radio tetangga, Andi mendengar dokter menjelaskan kapan pasangan sebaiknya bersetubuh agar cepat hamil.
sentences.en: From the neighbor's radio, Andi heard a doctor explain when couples should have intercourse to conceive quickly.
sentences.ko: 안디는 이웃집 라디오에서 의사가 임신하려면 부부가 언제 관계를 갖는 게 좋은지 설명하는 걸 들었어요.

sentences.text: Sambil menunggu les, Dewi membaca buku anaknya yang menjelaskan bahwa ikan tidak bersetubuh, tetapi bertelur di air.
sentences.en: While waiting for a lesson, Dewi read her child's book explaining that fish don't mate by intercourse but lay eggs in water.
sentences.ko: 데위는 수업을 기다리며 물고기는 교미하지 않고 물속에 알을 낳는다고 설명하는 아이 책을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Kucing tetangga sering mengencingi pot bunga di teras Andi.
sentences.en: The neighbor's cat often pees on the flower pots on Andi's porch.
sentences.ko: 이웃집 고양이가 안디네 현관 화분에 자주 오줌을 싸요.

sentences.text: Anak anjing Dewi mengencingi karpet di ruang latihan.
sentences.en: Dewi's puppy peed on the carpet in the practice room.
sentences.ko: 데위의 강아지가 연습실 카펫에 오줌을 쌌어요.

sentences.text: Lampu jalan di depan rumah Andi mulai meredup menjelang tengah malam.
sentences.en: The streetlight in front of Andi's house starts to dim toward midnight.
sentences.ko: 안디네 집 앞 가로등은 자정 무렵이면 흐려지기 시작해요.

sentences.text: Lampu panggung meredup, lalu murid-murid Dewi mulai memainkan lagu pembuka.
sentences.en: The stage lights dimmed, and Dewi's students began playing the opening piece.
sentences.ko: 무대 조명이 어두워지자 데위의 학생들이 첫 곡을 연주하기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Andi menegur anak-anak yang menindas bocah kecil di lapangan kompleks.
sentences.en: Andi scolded the kids who were bullying a little boy on the neighborhood field.
sentences.ko: 안디는 단지 운동장에서 꼬마를 괴롭히던 아이들을 꾸짖었어요.

sentences.text: Dewi tidak membiarkan murid senior menindas murid baru di ruang ganti.
sentences.en: Dewi doesn't let senior students bully new ones in the changing room.
sentences.ko: 데위는 선배 학생들이 탈의실에서 신입생을 괴롭히지 못하게 해요.

sentences.text: Saat Lebaran, Andi bersalaman dengan semua tetangga di masjid.
sentences.en: On Eid, Andi shook hands with all the neighbors at the mosque.
sentences.ko: 르바란에 안디는 모스크에서 이웃들과 모두 악수를 나눴어요.

sentences.text: Setelah resital, Dewi bersalaman dengan setiap orang tua murid.
sentences.en: After the recital, Dewi shook hands with every parent.
sentences.ko: 발표회가 끝나고 데위는 학부모 한 명 한 명과 악수했어요.

sentences.text: Andi merendam baju kotor semalaman sebelum mencucinya besok pagi.
sentences.en: Andi soaks dirty clothes overnight before washing them the next morning.
sentences.ko: 안디는 빨래를 밤새 물에 담가 뒀다가 다음 날 아침에 빨아요.

sentences.text: Dewi merendam corong klarinet dalam air hangat agar mudah dibersihkan.
sentences.en: Dewi soaks the clarinet mouthpiece in warm water so it's easy to clean.
sentences.ko: 데위는 클라리넷 마우스피스를 쉽게 닦으려고 따뜻한 물에 담가 둬요.
